template: In Odoo (signed in as admin), open the existing draft quotation with reference {{v1}} for customer '{{v2}} Bench Customer' and CONFIRM it (click the Confirm button) so it becomes a sales order. Then report: (a) the order reference/name shown on the page after confirming, and (b) the exact status the app now shows in the status bar (e.g. 'Sales Order'). Also confirm the untaxed amount still reads {{04-open.untaxed_amount}}.

target.selector: div:nth-of-type(3) > div > table > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(1) > td:nth-of-type(2)
